title: cli.output.notification.SkipReason
description: Reasons the updater can skip a run *and emit a notification about it*.

anyOf.title: UnsupportedPlatform
anyOf.description: Host OS/arch combination doesn't have a release asset.

anyOf.title: DevTree
anyOf.description:
Binary is running out of a `target*/` directory — looks like a
dev build (`cargo run`), not an installed binary.

anyOf.title: IncompleteRelease
anyOf.description:
The latest release is missing one or more of the four expected
assets for this host triple. No partial updates: refuse the
whole run.
